realtime_memories.content: Turborepo monorepo with 10 subdomain apps (www, thoughts, docs, status, updates, lab, cli, metrics, links, dev) and shared packages (ui, lib, types, config). GitHub: https://github.com/anipotts/anipotts.com. The www app uses LOCAL window components while all 9 subdomains import from @anipotts/ui shared package. Shared UI built with tsup: 'pnpm --filter @anipotts/ui build'.

Required env vars: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, ADMIN_PASSWORD. PostHog gracefully skips init if key missing. Vercel: pnpm 10.x, vercel.json in apps/www/. Dev: 'pnpm turbo dev --concurrency=15'.

Accent: #61ABEA (was #a78bfa purple, migrated to blue across all apps). Handles: @anipottsbuilds (social), @anipotts (GitHub/LinkedIn). Email: contact@anipotts.com. Bio: 'minimal interfaces to orchestrate complex systems'. Terminal header format: 'ani@potts:~/[domain]' with responsive prefix hiding on mobile.
SEO: robots.txt, sitemap.ts, Person schema, OG cards. Headshot: /images/ani-potts-headshot.png. Wikidata blocked - use mobile data.

.gitignore includes .turbo and next-env.d.ts (build artifacts). tsconfig.json across subdomain apps uses jsx: preserve. All apps use JetBrains Mono font, design tokens in packages/styles/src/tokens.css.
